config.training: fresh PPO, 50% own q and 50% train-image episodes, uniform fixed appearance per episode
config.checkpoint_selection: fixed final timestep only; no reference-residual selection
config.reference_scope: 459 reused PPO09 reference trajectories, not own-policy/fresh CP calibration
config.task_gate: surrogate and train-library success>=95%, unsafe<=1%, timeout<=1%; sampled development only

reference_collection_provenance.appearance_distribution: weather and color sampled independently and uniformly per trajectory
reference_collection_provenance.deployment_rollout: image latent PPO; analytic AEBS state; CARLA renders only
